notes: 1.0.7: Nguon 'Folder anh tham chieu' gio gan 1 prompt theo TUNG folder anh. Chon folder goc, tool quet cac folder con, moi folder con doc prompt rieng tu file prompt.txt (cung nhan prompt.md/_prompt.txt/prompt). Moi anh trong folder = 1 video dung prompt cua folder do, anh dung xong van bi xoa. Thu muc ra dat theo TEN folder anh dau vao (NN_<ten folder vao>) va chay lai thi dung lai thu muc cu. Folder thieu prompt.txt thi lay prompt theo thu tu o PROMPT VIDEO (nhan bao ro so folder thieu). Them nut 'Ghi prompt.txt' de ghi nhanh prompt tu o PROMPT VIDEO vao tung folder con.
